mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization (name, org_type, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{orgType}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO organization_member (organization_id, user_id, role, status, created_at) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT om.id, om.organization_id, om.user_id, om.role, om.status, om.created_at, om.updated_at FROM organization_member om JOIN organization o ON o.id = om.organization_id WHERE om.user_id = #{userId} AND om.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.org_type = 'PERSONAL' AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY om.created_at ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (user_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, ip_address, user_agent) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent})
INSERT INTO password_reset_token (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
